annotations.title: Append content to a section of a Joplin note

joplin_append_to_section.description:
Append text to a named section of a note without rewriting the rest.

Locates the unique '#'*level + section_heading line in the current body,
inserts `content` at the top or bottom of that section (delimited by the
next equal-or-higher heading), and writes the result back via modify_note.

Returns:
    JSON with success / error envelope.

content.description: Text to insert into the section. A trailing newline is added if missing.
content.title: Content

heading_level.description: Markdown heading level to match (1-6). Default 2 (## Heading).
heading_level.title: Heading Level

note_id.description: The ID of the note to update
note_id.title: Note Id

position.description: 'top' inserts immediately after the heading line, 'bottom' inserts at the end of the section.
position.title: Position

section_heading.description: Heading text to locate, e.g. 'Done (recent)'. Matched against a Markdown heading line of the given level.
section_heading.title: Section Heading

joplin_append_to_section.name: joplin_append_to_section

annotations.title: Apply a list of unique search/replace operations to a Joplin note

joplin_apply_patch.description:
Apply ordered search/replace operations atomically.

Each operation's `search` string must occur exactly once in the body at the
time it is applied. Operations are applied in order, so an earlier
replacement can create context for a later search. If any operation fails
(search_not_found or search_not_unique), no write occurs.

Returns:
    JSON with success / error envelope.

note_id.description: The ID of the note to update
note_id.title: Note Id

operations.description: Ordered list of search/replace operations. Each search string must occur exactly once in the current body. All operations are validated before any write; if any fails, no write occurs.
operations.title: Operations

replace.description: Replacement text. Empty string deletes the search match.
replace.title: Replace

search.description: Exact substring to find in the note body. Must occur exactly once.
search.title: Search

joplin_apply_patch.name: joplin_apply_patch
